intro: On TikTok, people decide in a moment whether to watch or swipe, so your product needs to show up right away and look like it belongs in the feed. AIVideosUGC turns one product photo and a short description into a vertical video ad of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. You might describe a hand lifting the product off a desk, a bottle on a gym bench, or a phone case catching the light, and the clip is built around that moment.

It suits sellers trying their first TikTok ad and marketers who need a new angle every week without booking a shoot. Each video is made one at a time, with the credit cost shown before you start. Want a different opening? Run another version. Once you download the file, add captions, a sound and your offer in TikTok or CapCut, then upload it to TikTok Ads Manager.
tips: Keep the product clear of the right edge and the bottom of the frame, where TikTok's buttons and caption sit.
To compare a new opening, make another version and change only the first scene; use Ads Manager to compare the results.

faq.q: Can I send the video straight to TikTok from AIVideosUGC?
faq.a: No. Download the file, then upload it in TikTok Ads Manager or the TikTok app. That's also where you can add captions and pick a sound.

faq.q: How long should my TikTok ad be?
faq.a: There's no single right length. Six seconds suits one striking shot, while 15 seconds leaves room to show the product being used. Try more than one and compare.

faq.q: Does the video come with music?
faq.a: We don't add music, so choose a sound in TikTok or CapCut before you post.

faq.q: Do I need to label an AI-generated ad on TikTok?
faq.a: TikTok’s AI-content labeling control can vary by creative and market. Apply the in-app label when Ads Manager marks it as required.

overview.h2: Build the first TikTok beat around the product
overview.d: Start with one product action that reads without an explanation: a lid opening, a zipper closing, a brush clearing crumbs, or a bottle placed beside a sink. Upload the clearest photo you own, name the setting and movement in one sentence, and keep the product in view before the action begins.

overview.h2: Match the file to the placement
overview.d: TikTok's In-Feed guide recommends 9:16 at 540×960 or larger for a vertical file; it also lists 1:1 at 640×640 and 16:9 at 960×540. Non-Spark In-Feed uploads can be up to 10 minutes and 500 MB, while TikTok's ad format guide lists 5–60 seconds. AIVideosUGC offers five video shapes—9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4—and 6, 10, 15, and 30 second jobs, with the cost shown before you run each one. Treat those product choices as the source for the file you export, review [TikTok's In-Feed ad specs](https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/tiktok-auction-in-feed-ads) before launch.

input_guide.h2: Prepare one photo for a readable first frame

items.d: Include the parts that will move or be handled, such as a bottle cap, shoe laces, or a bag strap. A missing edge gives the scene less to work with.
Describe one handoff, pour, open, turn, or use. A single action is easier to judge than a list of unrelated movements.
Compose the source so the product can sit away from the lower and side edges. Add exact captions later, after seeing where TikTok places buttons and text.

results.h2: What the first version should answer

items.d: The opening frame should make the product recognizable without a title card.
The movement should show one use or one useful detail, rather than a vague camera sweep.
The downloaded clip is a visual starting point. Add the exact price, claim, caption, sound, and call to action in TikTok or another editor.

scene_recipes.h2: Scenes to describe in one sentence

items.d: A hand places a compact cable organizer beside a laptop, then closes the case on a tidy desk.
A chilled tea can opens beside a glass with ice, and the amber drink pours across the center of the frame.
A sneaker rotates slowly on a clean bench, revealing the side stitching before the toe points toward camera.
A canvas tote moves from a cafe chair to a shoulder, with the handles and front pocket visible.

after_download.h2: Finish the TikTok file before upload

items.d: Type prices, offers, dates, and product names in TikTok, CapCut, or your chosen editor so every character is correct.
Add music or a sound in TikTok or an editing app; the generated file does not include an audio track.
Watch the complete file in the intended placement and make sure controls do not cover the product or your added text.
Review TikTok's current AI-content and advertising controls when you upload, because requirements can vary by creative and market.
